lens: J - Nordic design and materials advantage
slice: D3 - personal, lifestyle, fashion accessories, beauty-adjacent

ideas.name: Ash-wood Hair Stick Set
ideas.concept: Turned FSC ash/birch hair sticks and a bun fork with a tiny-run brass end cap, sold as a 2-piece gift set with linen pouch.
ideas.target_customer: Women 25-45 in SE/DK with long hair, design-conscious gift buyers
ideas.problem_solved: Heat/elastic-free updo; replaces plastic claw clips with a premium look
ideas.trend_evidence: UNVERIFIED: web search and Firecrawl were unavailable (budget/credits exhausted), so no trend data was checked. Idea rests on general knowledge of the hair-stick/clip revival only.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Signature proportions/ergonomics, Nordic wood sourcing story, named designer collabs; weak IP so brand is the moat

ideas.name: Wool Felt Everyday Carry Sleeves
ideas.concept: Pressed Nordic-style wool felt sleeves for AirPods case, lip balm, cards and keys, with a laser-cut modular snap system.
ideas.target_customer: Design-minded urban adults, corporate gifting in SE/DK
ideas.problem_solved: Pocket clutter with a tactile leather-free premium alternative
ideas.trend_evidence: UNVERIFIED: could not run searches; felt/leather-alternative demand is assumed, not evidenced.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Registered community design for the modular snap geometry; colourway collabs; B2B gifting

ideas.name: Linen Travel Jewellery Roll
ideas.concept: Washed European linen roll with cork-lined compartments and an anti-tarnish interior, sized for carry-on.
ideas.target_customer: Women 28-55, frequent short-trip travellers, gift buyers
ideas.problem_solved: Tangled and tarnished jewellery on trips
ideas.trend_evidence: UNVERIFIED: no searches possible this run; treat as hypothesis to validate via Google Trends and Amazon BSR.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Cut-and-sew pattern and Nordic linen heritage story; Portuguese/Baltic small-run makers; crowded generic space so brand matters

ideas.name: Refillable Brass Solid Fragrance Compact
ideas.concept: Weighted brass pocket compact with refill pucks in Nordic botanical scents (juniper, birch tar, cloudberry), non-medical cosmetic only.
ideas.problem_solved: Liquid-free carry-on fragrance with refill repeat purchase
ideas.trend_evidence: UNVERIFIED: no search results obtained; niche-fragrance and refill interest is assumed.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Proprietary scent formulations plus compact design; refill subscription lock-in; needs CPNP notification and cosmetic safety report (cost risk)

ideas.name: Cork-and-Wool Minimal Card Holder
ideas.concept: Portuguese cork bonded to wool felt, slim 6-card holder with RFID-free simple pull tab; vegan leather alternative.
ideas.target_customer: Men and women 25-40 who want slim wallets, vegan buyers
ideas.problem_solved: Bulky wallets; wants a non-leather premium feel
ideas.trend_evidence: UNVERIFIED: no searches possible; flooded wallet category likely, so risk is high.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Material pairing and colour system; limited editions with Nordic designers; weak IP

ideas.name: Birch Wood Beard/Hair Comb with Linen Case
ideas.concept: Wide-tooth laser-cut birch comb, oiled finish, with a linen travel case; unisex, no health claims.
ideas.target_customer: Men and women 22-50 wanting plastic-free grooming
ideas.problem_solved: Static-free everyday detangling in a premium, giftable form
ideas.trend_evidence: UNVERIFIED: search tools unavailable; wooden comb demand assumed from general market knowledge.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Tooth geometry and finish spec; engraved personalisation; Nordic origin story
